title: Psalms 65
paragraphs: ¹ Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion; to you vows will be fulfilled. ² O you who hear prayer, to you all flesh will come. ³ When we are overwhelmed by our sins, you forgive our transgressions. ⁴ Blessed is the one you choose and bring near to dwell in your courts! We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, the holiness of your temple. ⁵ With awesome deeds you answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

⁶ the one who by his strength set the mountains in place, girded with power, ⁷ who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, the uproar of the nations. ⁸ The inhabitants of the ends of the earth stand in awe at your signs. You make the gateways of morning and evening to shout for joy. ⁹ You visit the earth and water it; you greatly enrich it — the river of God is full of water. You provide the people with grain, for so you have prepared it. ¹⁰ You water its furrows abundantly, settling its ridges, softening it with showers, blessing its growth.

¹¹ You crown the year with your goodness, and your paths overflow with abundance. ¹² The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are wrapped in joy. ¹³ The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys are decked with grain — they shout for joy, they sing.
